name: Uri (father of Bezalel)
title: Father of the craftsman
summary: Uri was the son of Hur from the tribe of Judah and the father of Bezalel, the gifted craftsman who led the construction of the tabernacle. Through his son, Uri contributed to Israel's most holy building project in the wilderness.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Bezalel's lineage
keyEvents.description: Uri is mentioned as a link in the lineage from Hur to Bezalel, the chosen craftsman for the tabernacle. His family belonged to the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Bezalel's calling confirmed
keyEvents.description: God called Bezalel, son of Uri, son of Hur, and filled him with his Spirit to carry out the holy craft.

keyEvents.title: The lineage in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Uri's place in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah is confirmed in Chronicles, showing his connection to the line of Caleb.
